writeup: TIC 257927198 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 8.6780 days. The system shows a primary eclipse that dims the star by 29.68 percent, along with a detected secondary eclipse at 7.6 sigma significance. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 97.8 in difference imaging. The automated detection pipeline achieved a signal-to-noise ratio of 2065.5 using the Box Least Squares method, and the system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. With a machine learning screening score of 0.99, this candidate merits further investigation to determine whether the eclipsing binary interpretation is correct.
